title: governance: persist doc-level quality + char stats for audit (no parsed markdown)
description:
Problem
- Governance audit char reduction distribution currently depends on persist_parsed_content. This can be expensive and privacy-sensitive.
- Governance quality metrics (density/heading_ratio/etc) are computed per-item but not persisted at the document level for dataset reporting/tuning.

Goal
- Persist lightweight, privacy-safe doc-level governance metrics (char counts + quality metrics) in document.doc_metadata so dataset reports and report center can visualize governance effects without storing markdown content.

Acceptance Criteria
- Ingestion pipeline records governance char stats (original_chars/cleaned_chars/reduction_pct) for governance-enabled runs.
- Ingestion pipeline records governance quality metrics (density, heading_ratio, etc) at document level.
- Dataset report governance_audit uses these stats as fallback when parsed_content_persisted is missing.
- Frontend report center shows char reduction distribution even when persist_parsed_content is off (via fallback stats), and adds basic governance quality distribution (density + heading_ratio).
- Tests cover aggregation + metadata recording.
